advisories.title: Cortex XSOAR: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature in Microsoft Teams integration
advisories.summary: An improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability exists in Cortex XSOAR and Cortex XSIAM platforms during integration of Microsoft Teams that enables an unauthenticated user to access and modify protected resources.

advisories.title: Autonomous Digital Experience Manager: Improper validation of ADEM certificate
advisories.summary: A certificate validation vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Autonomous Digital Experience Manager on Windows allows an unauthenticated attacker with adjacent network access to execute arbitrary code with NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges.

advisories.title: Cortex XDR Agent: Local Administrator can disable the agent on Windows
advisories.summary: A problem with a protection mechanism in the Palo Alto Networks Cortex XDR agent on Windows allows a local Windows administrator to disable the agent. This issue may be leveraged by malware to perform malicious activity without detection.

advisories.title: Cortex XDR Broker VM: Sensitive Information Disclosure Vulnerability
advisories.summary: An information disclosure vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks Cortex XDR® Broker VM allows an authenticated user to obtain and modify sensitive information by triggering live terminal session via Cortex UI and modifying any configuration setting.

advisories.title: [MàJ] Vulnérabilité dans Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN (25 février 2026)
advisories.summary: Une vulnérabilité a été découverte dans Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN. Elle permet à un attaquant de provoquer un contournement de la politique de sécurité. Cisco indique que la vulnérabilité CVE-2026-20127 est activement exploitée.

advisories.title: LDAP authentication bypass in Agentless VPN and FSSO
advisories.summary: An Authentication Bypass by Primary Weakness vulnerability [CWE-305] in FortiOS fnbamd may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass LDAP authentication of Agentless VPN or FSSO policy, under specific LDAP server configuration.

advisories.title: PAN-OS: Firewall Denial of Service (DoS) Using Specially Crafted Packets
advisories.summary: A denial-of-service (DoS) vulnerability in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS software enables an unauthenticated attacker to reboot a firewall by sending a specially crafted packet through the dataplane. Repeated attempts to initiate a reboot causes the firewall to enter maintenance mode.

advisories.title: PAN-OS: Improper Neutralization of Input in the Management Web Interface
advisories.summary: An improper input neutralization vulnerability in the management web interface of the Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated administrator to bypass system restrictions and execute arbitrary commands.

advisories.title: Information Disclosure on SSLVPN endpoint
advisories.summary: An Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor vulnerability [CWE-200] in FortiOS SSL-VPN web-mode may allow an authenticated user to access full SSL-VPN settings via crafted URL.

advisories.title: Vulnerability in OpenSSL library
advisories.summary: A security advisory was released affecting the version of OpenSSL library used in some Fortinet products:CVE-2022-0778:The BN_mod_sqrt() function, which computes a modular square root, contains a bug that can cause it to loop forever for non-prime moduli.

advisories.title: HTML injection in WebUI
advisories.summary: An improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags in a web page in FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer may allow an attacker to perform a cross site scripting (XSS) attack via the Identify Provider name field.
